mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 62 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, and the Moon is in a Waxing Gibbous phase. If you look up at 5:01 PM, you can catch the ISS rising over Cross Plains and moving toward Madison near the Home Depot, appearing low near the horizon.

The City of Verona announced that all city buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27. Additionally, residents should note that refuse and recycling pickup normally scheduled for Thursday will be delayed until Friday.
We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, plus yoga on November 23 and trivia nights starting November 25.
In a report covering November 1 through 15, on November 2, officers were dispatched to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
